channel.title: SpendSathi Blog | Personal Finance Tips
channel.description: Practical personal finance tips, UPI budgeting strategies, and money-saving insights from SpendSathi.

item.title: Base Health Insurance vs Super Top-Up: How to Get ₹50 Lakhs Coverage for Salaried Indians
item.description: Medical inflation in India is running at 14% annually. Relying solely on corporate group cover is dangerous. Here is how pairing a ₹5 Lakh base health plan with a ₹45 Lakh Super Top-up saves you over 60% on premiums.

item.title: The Credit Card Reward Trap: Are You Overspending Just for 1.5% Cashback?
item.description: Credit card reward points, air miles, and 1.5% cashback offers are engineered to trigger spending friction-loss. Here is the behavioral psychology behind reward traps and how to stay disciplined.

item.title: Old vs New Tax Regime in 2026: The Definitive Math Guide for Salaried Indians
item.description: Should you stick with Section 80C, HRA, and home loan deductions in the Old Regime, or switch to the simplified slabs of the New Tax Regime? Here is the exact breakeven formula to minimize your tax liability.

item.title: Digital Gold vs Sovereign Gold Bonds vs Equity SIP: The Modern Indian Dilemma
item.description: Gold is deeply woven into Indian culture, but how should modern investors allocate between digital gold, Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB), and equity mutual fund SIPs? Here is the balanced asset allocation guide.

item.title: The 750+ CIBIL Playbook: How Indian Borrowers Can Boost Their Credit Score in 90 Days
item.description: A credit score above 750 saves you lakhs in home loan interest. Here is the step-by-step playbook to repair your CIBIL score, optimize credit utilization, and remove reporting errors within 90 days.

item.title: Subscription Creep: How ₹199 Micro-Transactions Silently Steal ₹30,000 a Year
item.description: Between OTT streaming apps, quick commerce club memberships, cloud storage, and gym autopays, recurring subscriptions silently bleed Indian bank accounts. Here is how to conduct a ruthless subscription audit.

item.title: Step-Up SIP in India: How a 10% Annual Boost Multiplies Your Crorepati Timeline
item.description: A fixed ₹10,000 monthly SIP is good, but a Step-Up SIP is game-changing. Here is how increasing your mutual fund contributions by just 10% every year cuts years off your wealth creation goals.

item.title: Emergency Funds in 2026: The Liquid Safety Net Every Indian Professional Needs
item.description: How much cash should you hold in reserve during uncertain economic times? Here is how to structure a bulletproof emergency fund across liquid mutual funds and high-yield savings without risking market volatility.

item.title: The Debt Avalanche vs Snowball Method: How to Pay Off Credit Cards in India
item.description: Struggling with high-interest credit card revolving balances and personal loans? Here is how to choose between the Debt Avalanche and Debt Snowball methods tailored to Indian interest rates, and how local expense tracking keeps you accountable.

item.title: First of the Month Budgeting: Plan November Expenses
item.description: The first day of the month is your single greatest financial lever. Here is how to allocate your November salary using zero-based budgeting, and how SpendSathi's private offline expense tracking stops silent UPI leaks.

item.title: The Zero-Based Budgeting Guide for Indians: How to Give Every Rupee a Job in the UPI Era
item.description: When money sits unassigned in your savings account, high-frequency UPI scans slowly bleed it dry. Here is how Zero-Based Budgeting gives every single rupee an intentional mission before the month starts — and how automated local tracking makes it effortless.

item.title: 3 Hidden Ways You Are Leaking Money Every Month (And How to Stop It)
item.description: Most of us check our bank balance and think we're doing okay — until we do the math. Here are 3 silent money drains bleeding your wallet dry every month, and how a local-first approach stops them cold.

item.title: The Hidden Privacy Cost of Cloud Budgeting Apps: Is 'Free' Worth Your Financial Identity?
item.description: When an app tracks your net worth, reads your bank alerts, and gives it all to you for 'free,' how is it paying its engineers and cloud bills? Inside the data-broker economy of cloud personal finance apps, and why local-first architecture is the only true defense.

item.title: Emergency Funds in India: How Much Runway Do You Really Need in 2026?
item.description: Western personal finance rules blindly advocate for '3 to 6 months of expenses.' In the Indian socio-economic reality of tech layoffs, joint families, and private healthcare deductibles, here is how to calculate your true survival runway.

item.title: Why Cashless Payments Make You Spend More (And How to Bring the 'Pain of Paying' Back)
item.description: When you hand over a crisp ₹500 note, your brain registers physical loss. When you scan a QR code, you barely register the exchange at all. Here is the behavioral neuroscience behind digital spending, and how to reclaim your financial awareness.

item.title: The 50/30/20 Budgeting Rule for UPI Users: Why Traditional Budgeting Breaks in India
item.description: The legendary 50/30/20 budgeting rule was invented in the era of cash envelopes and physical checks. In an economy where you scan QR codes thirty times a day, here is how to adapt it so your budget doesn't collapse by mid-month.
